readiness.htp: requires live host OAuth/read smoke test
readiness.seosmith: adapter gated; no host operations shipped

auth.login: /mcp in interactive session; select plugin HTP server
auth.logout: Use host logout for actual registered server identity; revoke at HTP separately.
limitations: Noninteractive runs cannot complete the interactive /mcp OAuth flow.
Removing local tokens does not revoke the grant at issuer.

distribution.install: claude plugin marketplace add hatchertechnology/htp-claude; claude plugin install htp@htp
distribution.upgrade: Unverified; Wave 1 must document and test host update procedure.
distribution.rollback: Unverified; Wave 1 must test reinstalling previous pinned marketplace/plugin revision.
